visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The sequence opens in a serene Japanese garden setting during bright daylight. A woman with dark hair tied in a bun, wearing a beige textured jacket and a black skirt, sits on a weathered log bench. She is looking at a wide artificial waterfall that flows over dark rocks into a pond. In the background, a large multi-story hotel building stands prominently under a clear blue sky. (2) The scene transitions to a bright red arched bridge crossing a tranquil pond. The woman is seen walking across the bridge, surrounded by lush green trees and manicured shrubs. The hotel building is visible in the background, contrasting modern architecture with traditional landscaping. The lighting is natural and even. (3) The camera moves indoors to show a modern hotel room with dark grey walls and warm, dim lighting. The room features two twin beds with patterned bed runners and a small sitting area with a black table and a grey sofa. A close-up reveals a round silver Bluetooth speaker on a nightstand, and a subsequent shot shows the Tokyo city skyline at night through a large window, with the orange-lit Tokyo Tower visible. (4) Detail shots highlight various amenities: a gold-colored bottle of sake and a coffee machine with several capsules. The bathroom is shown with a black stone sink and a wooden box containing toiletries. A deep wooden bathtub is filled with clear water from a silver faucet, steam rising slightly. (5) Back outside, the exterior of the "Hotel New Otani Tokyo" is shown with many flags of different nations flying at the entrance. The woman walks through the garden again, highlighting the vastness of the green space. (6) The focus shifts to a breakfast buffet featuring a variety of dishes: pastries, fresh fruit, and bowls of salmon roe. A chef in a white uniform is seen using a spatula to fold an omelet on a large metal griddle. The woman is then shown sitting in a brightly lit restaurant with large glass windows overlooking the waterfall garden while enjoying her meal. (7) The final scene shows the woman standing in front of a traditional wooden garden gate. She waves to the camera and then steps through to close the gate. The screen fades to a graphic with social media handles and brand logos against a pink background.

The frequency balance is bright and crisp, with no audible distortion or clipping. (4) In the bathroom sequence, the music is joined by the realistic sound of water splashing and pouring into a tub.
